items.title: Restore the executable bit on package.json bin targets when dist is promoted
items.context: Probe rp-mtk46lj8-90q9av, review rr-mtk4acx4-oqze5c. scripts/promote-dist.mjs promoteDist must chmod every bin target listed in <packageRoot>/package.json after renaming staging into dist (both the main and utils builds share promoteDist). green-4-promote-dist.patch in .proof-or-stop/evidence/red-proofs/2026-09-02-framework-defects/ is the proven candidate.
items.userSees: After npm --prefix packages/main run build re-emits dist, ls -la packages/main/dist/cli.js shows -rwxr-xr-x and proof-or-stop --version prints the version instead of permission denied

happy.desc: After promoteDist promotes a staging tree whose bin target is 0644, the bin target listed in package.json is executable (mode has 0o111) and its content is unchanged
node packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs (evidence pack copy until CHK-002 commits it) exits 0 with the GREEN summary

edge.desc: promoteDist on a package whose bin target is absent (first build, partial fixture) completes without throwing and restores nothing
A second build right after the chmod takes the content-bound fast path (verifyBuildBinding passes), proving mode bits are not part of the binding digest

adversarial.desc: A package.json with no bin field, or an unreadable package.json, leaves promoteDist behaviour byte-identical to before (no throw, no chmod)

items.title: Commit red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs as a registered red test that is GREEN after the fix
items.context: Copy the script from .proof-or-stop/evidence/red-proofs/2026-09-02-framework-defects/ to packages/main/tests/red/, register it in proof-or-stop.config.json next to the other red tests, and run it in the worktree; it must exit 0 only because CHK-001 landed (rerun on main must still exit 1).
items.userSees: GREEN red-global-cli-exec-bit: rebuilds keep the global bin target executable

happy.desc: node packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs run from the worktree exits 0 and prints GREEN red-global-cli-exec-bit: rebuilds keep the global bin target executable

edge.desc: The red test is registered in proof-or-stop.config.json with the same shape as the sibling packages/main/tests/red entries and appears in proof-or-stop validation_plan output

adversarial.desc: Running the script with RED_REPO_ROOT pointing at the unfixed main checkout still exits 1 with the RED summary, proving it discriminates the pipeline fix

items.title: Make doctor verify the global executable realpath and mode with an exact repoint remediation
items.context: Draft symptom: /opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop resolved into .worktrees/B-fe8f. Extend core/runtime-environment-checks.ts checkGlobalCoreRealpath (see tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs) to also assert the bin target is executable and print the exact npm link / repoint command.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop doctor prints a global-cli row with realpath, version and mode, and a one-line remediation when any of them drift
